body:
I was only recently diagnosed with ADHD after a very problematic childhood. When I am not procrastinating, I seek perfectionism and have realised in the last few years that I have always had anxiety (extreme performance anxiety, public speaking, etc), but thought everyone felt this way.
My wife recently got prescribed Propranolol for high blood pressure due to anxiety (10mg x 3 a day).
Upon reading up on them, I took one and went to work. I didn't notice any difference. Then a few days later, I had to chair a meeting with senior staff, then give a presentation to another govt organization. Normally I would be stressing, going red, tripping over my words. But when It was finished, I realized I did not once trip, stumble, felt embarrassed or forget the moment I was in. It was just like the movie Limitless. Not high, just clear headed and confident.
I am keeping stash for any future interviews, speaking engagements or social occasions where its awkward.
Totally recommend for the embarrassed introvert; although I am an ADHD paradox social butterfly when I'm not shaking anxiously about public engagements.
